notes.title: New patch! Updated tutorial
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34139825/8412633a91f868968c1af3c0c1d4ccb6ecf22fc5.png[/img]

Hi everyone!

We just updated the game with a new patch that completely revamps the Tutorial section with the feedback we've received from users. It is now more thorough and the gameplay mechanics are explained in greater detail. Hope this makes the experience smoother for everyone!

Here's a quick summary of this patch's notes:
[list]
[*] Redesigned tutorial for a better gameplay clarity
[*] Version number upped to 1.00.600
[/list]

tags.feature: Redesigned tutorial for a better gameplay clarity
